after_snippet:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({'cat': pd.Categorical(['a','b','a']), 'val': [1,2,3]})
# In pandas 3.0, observed=True is the default
result = df.groupby('cat', observed=True).sum()
assert len(result) == 2
before_snippet:
import pandas as pd
import warnings

df = pd.DataFrame({'cat': pd.Categorical(['a','b','a']), 'val': [1,2,3]})
# In pandas 2.x, not passing observed raises FutureWarning but works
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('ignore', FutureWarning)
    result = df.groupby('cat').sum()
assert len(result) == 2
title: DataFrame.groupby with observed=False no longer defaults to True for categorical groupers
